input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for account containers configuration, account, account repository. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with transfer functionality, so that I can accomplish my transfer-related tasks.
